project.name: Kingsperl Events
project.objective: Completely reimagine Kingsperl Events with a distinctive contemporary visual identity, generous readable typography and a cohesive customer planning experience.
project.audience: Event hosts in St. John's and the Avalon Peninsula
project.governing_idea: An architectural K, an event arch and a pearl unify the identity.

creative_system.visual_thesis: A vivid violet opening, a coral-and-lilac event photograph, fresh-lime accents and open photographic layouts create an imaginative contemporary event studio.

palette.contrast: White and fresh lime on violet; dark plum text on pale surfaces.

creative_system.composition: Oversized type, a framed photographic hero, varied service imagery, generous spacing, clear grouped controls and shared navigation.
creative_system.camera: Grounded perspective, motivated movement, and stable screen direction.
creative_system.lighting: Motivated practical sources with consistent direction and softness.
creative_system.typography: Self-hosted Plus Jakarta Sans, bold expressive headings and clear 17–19px supporting copy; no Gothic display fonts.
creative_system.motion: Existing restrained website transitions with reduced-motion support.
creative_system.interface: Clear hierarchy, responsive reflow, keyboard access, and reduced-motion parity.
invariants: Keep approved identity, product geometry, palette roles, and logo treatment consistent.
permitted_variations: Adapt composition and pacing to aspect ratio and placement.

assets.description: Original K, arch and pearl geometry with outlined wordmark.
ImageGen cinematic Kingsperl Events card, 1200 by 630 pixels; optimized from the approved 1730 by 909 master.
assets.notes: Generated with the original mark and the existing glasshouse concept as references; not a completed-client-event photograph.

assets.description: 512-pixel icon rendered from original vector geometry.
Original photorealistic coral-and-lilac celebration concept, with flowers, sculptural drapery and refined tables.
assets.notes: Generated with built-in ImageGen for this project. Interface explicitly labels it as a design concept, not completed client work.
assets.prompt: Create a spectacular high-end event design photograph, landscape 3:2, an airy architectural pavilion with coral and vermilion draping, coral and lavender floral arrangements, cherry-red sculptural plinths, ivory linen, violet-tinted glassware and brushed-metal chairs. A circular floral installation through tall draped arches. Professional architectural editorial photography, warm side daylight, realistic materials and scale, 35mm perspective. No people, text, logos, watermarks, or black-and-gold styling. Aspirational event concept imagery.

rights_and_claims.description: New original logo geometry; generated concept social card.
rights_and_claims.evidence: Current user request to design assets for Kingsperl Events.

review_notes: Production build and 15 automated planning/security checks passed during development.
All visible supporting text is at least 14px; body text and controls use larger legible sizes.

assumptions: Brand scope remains the existing St. John's event-design company.

direction_record.selection_reason: The expressive direction is substantially different from both rejected designs and gives photography and clean readable typography the main roles.
